subject: Vendor onboarding: security & procurement package for Valeon
messages:
From: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@valeon.io>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Valeon onboarding — docs needed (DPA / SOC2 / subs)

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — our procurement team is ready to move forward but has a standard checklist they need before we can generate a PO. Specifically they requested: 

- Redwood Data Processing Agreement (DPA) signed or DocuSign link
- Current SOC 2 Type II report (or link) and expected retention window for logs
- Current subprocessor list (including cloud providers and any analytics tooling)
- Vendor onboarding form (company details, TAX/W9, bank details)

I've attached our vendor onboarding form and W9 to this email for your reference. Also, can you confirm the PO process (who to invoice, billing cadence) and whether you require a vendor portal registration?

Thanks — if it's easier I can loop in our procurement lead, Brian Cho.

Best,
Samantha Reed
Vendor Operations
Valeon Therapeutics
Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf, w9_valeon.pdf
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@valeon.io>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Valeon onboarding — docs needed (DPA / SOC2 / subs)

Hi Samantha — great to hear, and thanks for sending the onboarding packet. Looping in Aditya (account lead) and Marissa (finance) so we can get everything over to your procurement team.

Quick summary of what I'm attaching and next steps:

1) Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf (attached) — we usually send the DPA via DocuSign for signature. I'll create the envelope today unless you prefer to redline first; if you have specific language requests please flag them.

2) SOC 2 report — public read-only link below (we host the certified report in a secured S3 location). The report is our latest Type II covering Jan–Dec 2025.
   https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/reports/SOC2-TypeII-2026.pdf

3) Subprocessor list (attached) — subprocessor_list_2026-04.xlsx lists primary cloud providers, analytics, monitoring, and support vendors. We keep this updated quarterly.

4) PO process / invoicing: 
   - Please issue PO to: Redwood Inference, Inc.
   - Billing contact: billing@redwood.ai (cc'd to Marissa)
   - Invoice cadence: monthly in arrears unless a prepaid commitment is requested
   - PO should reference our legal entity and the HubSpot deal id (VAL-2026-92731) to speed processing

5) Attachments I am sending: Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf, subprocessor_list_2026-04.xlsx, PO_instructions.docx, PO_template.docx

If you want to redline the DPA prior to DocuSign, please send proposed changes; our legal team typically reviews minor edits within 48 hours.

I'll kick off the DocuSign today and confirm once it is sent. Aditya — feel free to add anything on commercial terms or timelines.

Thanks,

Lauren Bishop
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182
Redwood Inference — inference for production
Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf, subprocessor_list_2026-04.xlsx, PO_instructions.docx, PO_template.docx
From: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@valeon.io>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: Brian Cho <brian.cho@valeon.io>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Valeon onboarding — docs needed (DPA / SOC2 / subs)

Thanks Lauren — this is really helpful. A couple of follow-ups from procurement: 

- They asked whether Redwood has any vendor-side retention windows for audit logs and whether you support custom retention for regulated customers.
- Our legal team is reviewing the DPA. They flagged the indemnity paragraph and asked if Redwood would accept a small redline to carve out client data processed under a HIPAA-defined PHI context. Is that something we can handle?
- For PO processing: can you confirm whether Redwood accepts ACH payments (we will need bank details / remittance) and whether you require a PO number on the invoice for automated processing.

Attaching Brian's contact for procurement. He will start the PO intake once we've got the signed DPA and W9.

Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Valeon onboarding — docs needed (DPA / SOC2 / subs)

Hi Samantha / Brian —

Following up with everything consolidated: 

- DocuSign: I created the envelope for Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf and added Valeon as a signer. You should receive the DocuSign notification today. If your legal team wants to propose redlines instead of signing, send them back to legal@redwood.ai and CC me; our legal ops triages those within ~48–72 hours.

- SOC2 link: secure copy here — https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/reports/SOC2-TypeII-2026.pdf (access limited to recipients of the link). It shows our controls and the monitoring/retention notes in section 4.

- Subprocessor list: attached (subprocessor_list_2026-04.xlsx). Key entries: AWS (us-west-2), Google Analytics (for web analytics), Datadog (monitoring), SendGrid (transactional email). If you need a signed subprocessor addendum for a specific vendor, let us know which one and why.

- PO and invoicing: PO_template.docx attached — please include the PO number on the invoice; we accept ACH (details below) and wire. For ACH remittance please send to: 
   Redwood Inference, Inc.
   Bank: First Pacific Bank
   Routing: 111000025
   Acct: 6582100047
   (Note: please confirm remittance to billing@redwood.ai)

- W9: we do not require Valeon's W9 until the PO is issued; once PO is started, our finance team will request the W9 as part of vendor setup.

If everything looks good I recommend your procurement issues the PO and we will confirm once vendor setup is complete on our side.

Thanks all — excited to get Valeon onboarded.

Lauren
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: subprocessor_list_2026-04.xlsx, PO_template.docx
